description:
Live Google results for any keyword in a country: the organic top 10–30, whether an AI Overview shows and which domains it cites, the featured snippet owner, People Also Ask, the SERP features and, with target_domain or site_id, where that site ranks. position = organic place, 1 = first result (features not counted), as Search Console and track_keywords count it.

Billing: 5¢ per call. Not billed when nothing comes back or the call fails; the same call within 24h is free. No-account server: one free data call a day without credit.

When to call: who ranks for a keyword right now, whether its AI Overview cites a domain, or a look at the results before rewriting a page. To watch a keyword weekly: track_keywords.

Returns { keyword, country, device, ai_overview: {present, cited_domains}, featured_snippet_owner, people_also_ask, serp_features, results: [{position, domain, url, url_source?, breadcrumb?, unresolved?, title, description}], hidden_url_count, own_position?: {domain, status: found|not_found|unknown, position, url, ai_overview_cited}, google_url, cached, charged_cents }. A result Google hides behind a redirect takes its domain from the breadcrumb (url from another link to the page, url_source; else null with breadcrumb naming the page). unresolved: no site could be read. own_position also searches 10 extra results.

country.description: Google market, ISO code (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, IN, SG, ZA, AE, DE, AT, CH, FR, ES, IT, NL, SE, FI, MX, BR). Default US.

site_id.description: Optional, instead of target_domain: a workspace site (list_sites) to find in the results.

target_domain.description: Optional: a domain to find in the results, e.g. "acme.com" (own_position).

name: get_serp
title: Google results for any keyword
